title: HaHello
description: Who the phone is, at pairing and at every re-pairing (a new phone, a reinstall, a sign-in again), sealed under the pairing link's key. A hello from a known account_ref updates that entry (key, URLs) and resets its revisions. Frozen at schema_version 1 forever, new optional keys only: the phone learns what HA reads from the ack to it (`reads`, per kind, as `writes` here). Never queued in the outbox: the pairing seals and posts it itself (README «The outbox and the store»). `account_ref`, `revision` (the live sequence) and `phone_now` are the native poster's stamps.

display_name.description: The profile's name, for the device's name («RAW <name>»); absent without one: «RAW».

writes.description: Per kind, the schema_versions this phone can write, as the ack's `reads` (ha_ack.schema.json): it writes each kind at the highest version both hold, and RAW says which side to update when they share none.

account_ref.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the RAW account id keyed by HA's instance id (the custom webhook's: keyed by its URL), lowercase hex.
